summary: All 4 feature groups verified on 390x844 mobile viewport — no regressions. (1) EDITOR status bar: sample.js opens; cursor-position='Ln 1, Col 1', word-count='58 words', char-count='393 chars', line-count='23 lines'. Typing ' X' at caret updates char-count 393->395 and word-count 58->59. DOM has exactly 1 textarea/input (TEXT_INPUTS_COUNT=1) — no second overlay layer, confirming the single-layer RichEditor removes the ghost-text bug. Undo/redo buttons rendered. Find for 'greet' => find-count '1/2'. (2) SETTINGS: settings-screen loads; global-font-section visible; chips global-font-palette-dracula/monokai, global-font-color-auto all present; line-spacing-1.3/1.5/1.8 segmented all present. Per-language chip lang-style-python selects python; lang-font-size-plus and lang-font-palette-dracula buttons present and tappable; reset-lang-style-btn present. Theme toggle to Light applied; after full page reload the theme persists (updateSettings is wired through storage) and settings-screen still loads with no errors. (3) COMPARE: /compare screen loads via home open-compare-btn. 'The quick brown fox jumps' vs 'The quick red fox leaps high' -> compare-results renders similarity-value='54.5%', stat-added=3, stat-removed=2, stat-changed=3, stat-same=3. 2 diff chunks with locations 'A: Ln 1, Col 11 → B: Ln 1, Col 11' and inline '- brown + red' labels. compare-view-same and compare-view-inline render; compare-mode-lines re-runs results. 3 compare-history-* entries created; tapping an entry re-runs comparison and compare-recount reads '2 differences found · A: 5 words · B: 6 words · previous run: 54.5% similar, 2 differences'. pick-file-a opens sheet with 2 pick-doc-* rows; selecting one fills compare-input-a (length 517). (4) EDITOR 'More' -> more-compare navigates to /compare with Text A pre-filled from the current document (length 395 chars matches edited sample.js content). No red screen, no console errors.
critical_code_review_comments: RichEditor.tsx: Correctly uses a single TextInput with nested <Text> colored children on native (children + value disjunction at line 129). On web it falls back to `value` (children=null when IS_WEB), eliminating double-text rendering. Measurement layer (line 170) is invisible (opacity 0) with pointerEvents=none so it cannot steal taps.

compare.ts: LCS-based diff with pre/suffix trimming, locator() correctly tracks line/col for both A and B. tooLarge fallback at n*m>4M prevents DP blowup. Similarity formula uses 2*same/(unitsA+unitsB) — matches Dice coefficient semantics.

compare.tsx: history recount works because run() looks up `prev` by (nameA,nameB,mode) from current history BEFORE unshifting the new record, so prevSummary reflects the actual last run, not the one just saved. Good.

settings.tsx: FontStyleEditor usage uses testID prefix 'global-font' and 'lang-font' matching the review-request chip ids (global-font-palette-dracula, lang-font-size-plus, lang-font-palette-dracula, etc.).
seed_data_creation: Used built-in seeded docs (sample.js, Welcome.md) and typed-in text; 3 compare history entries created during the run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Mobile viewport 390x844. Compare screen reachable from home open-compare-btn and from editor more sheet (more-compare, pre-fills Text A from current doc). History entry testIDs are compare-history-<id>; tapping replays and the compare-recount text includes 'previous run: X% similar, N differences' when a prior run with same (nameA,nameB,mode) exists. Settings persistence works across full page reload. The 'ghost text' concern is a native-only issue; on web the RichEditor uses TextInput value (single DOM textarea), so there's nothing to visually verify beyond 'TEXT_INPUTS_COUNT=1' which is confirmed.
